### Provider Statement
According to the GitHub Corporate Terms of Service and GitHub Customer Agreements:
> *“‘GitHub’ means GitHub, Inc., its Affiliates, and its Representatives.”*  
> *“This GitHub Data Protection Agreement forms part of the GitHub Customer Agreement between Customer (‘You’) and GitHub, Inc., (‘GitHub’) covering Your legal entity's use of the Online Services.”*
